mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in WORKPLACES mobility from -42.6 to -39.3 over four weekly means signals returning commuting routines that lift weekday retail footfall, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES continues to rise or remains above -40.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility dropping from 5.0 to -2.6 indicates outdoor recreation demand collapsing, which substitutes into indoor retail and recreation trips and raises RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below 0 percent change baseline for at least one week
regime_hint: cooling weather or tightened outdoor access
failure_condition: PARKS remains below 0 percent change but RETAIL_REC declines over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint pattern of WORKPLACES improving above -40 while TRANSIT stays below -30 indicates commuting is returning without adequate transit capacity, constraining discretionary retail trips and lowering RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days while WORKPLACES is above -40 and TRANSIT is below -30.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility remaining elevated and rising from 8.3 to 8.7 signals persistent stay-at-home behavior that suppresses retail trips, producing lower RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
regime_hint: steady state with high residential mobility
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL remains above 8 percent change but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening restrictions regime, GROCERY_PHARM falling from -10.7 to -12.0 signals reduced essential shopping and renewed caution, which spills over into lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below -11 percent change baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM remains below -11 percent change but RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved for three consecutive weeks and crossed above -35.0, indicating positive short-term momentum that carries into higher RETAIL_REC over the next one week.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC > -35.0 percent change for one week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next 7 days despite being above -35.0 percent change at the decision point.
